Go to the Military Security Area and meet with Lucia

Lucia goes over the details of the medal ceremony with you once more through communication. You should get ready and head to the Military Security Area now—wouldn't want to keep everyone waiting too long.
Go to F.O.S. Military Command College

Peace has returned to F.O.S., and now, the campus is quieter than usual due to the upcoming medal ceremony. After talking for a bit, Vanessa suggests that you take Lucia to look around and use this opportunity to collect your thoughts before it's time to head to the Golden Hall.
